bio: This attractive neighbourhood restaurant, located along a tranquil tree-lined street away from the busy tourist heart of the city, boasts an everyday, informal ambience, along with a simple pavement terrace and striking touches of color in the dining room, with its open kitchen. It’s mainly local clientele flock here to enjoy dishes from the concise à la carte that are an updated take on Greek recipes and based around fresh, seasonal and locally sourced ingredients that showcase the country’s cuisine to the full....
